# Badger Basement Systems

> > Foundation repair, basement waterproofing, crawl space encapsulation, and concrete leveling contractor serving Southern Wisconsin and Northern Illinois.

Badger Basement Systems specializes in comprehensive home foundation solutions including PolyLevel concrete lifting, CleanSpace crawl space encapsulation, and structural waterproofing systems. The company serves the Madison, Milwaukee, Janesville, and Rockford metro areas with products like SaniDry dehumidifiers and EverLast crawl space doors.
